page.overview:
What is Migohai Gaimika?

The Migohai Gaimika was Donquixote Mjosgard's personal ship.

The Migohai Gaimika was a large ship with four masts. The first mast had a single sail with the World Government's symbol printed on it, and the latter three had two large sails each. The figurehead of the ship was a smirking mouse or rat's head, wearing a crown. It had cannons lining its sides.

The masts were tall enough to be visible from most of the Ryugu Kingdom.

Mjosgard took the Migohai Gaimika to travel to Fish-Man Island in search of his escaped slaves. While sailing down, the ship was attacked by the Sea Floor's fauna, wrecking the ship and leaving Mjosgard as the only survivor.
